name: session-cleanup
description: The /cleanup command lists the temporary files the session created and the Git items it left (uncommitted changes, changed submodules, a detached HEAD, unpushed commits); choose what to send to the trash and what to ask Claude to fix.

removeMode.title: How Remove removes a file
removeMode.description: trash: the system trash (the Recycle Bin on Windows); a file the trash refuses goes to the quarantine folder. quarantine: move to ~/.claude/cleanup-quarantine, where each run is kept for the days below. delete: delete for good.

quarantineDays.title: Days a quarantine run is kept
quarantineDays.description: When a session starts, the mod deletes the quarantine runs older than this many days.
